decisions.rationale: Title mention of the named condition 'Glucose/galactose malabsorption', which refers to one defined disease (GGM) with no further categorization.

decisions.rationale: Long form of the abbreviation definition for GGM in the abstract, naming one specific disease. Annotated separately from its abbreviation.

decisions.rationale: 'autosomal recessive disease' denotes a family of diseases defined by inheritance pattern rather than one specific disease, matching the guideline's own example.
